name: ELAM-7B
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from allenai/Molmo-7B-D-0924 (config.json max_position_embeddings 4096). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-11-02. A finetune of allenai/Molmo-7B-D-0924, not a new base model: same config.json, same 8.021 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2025-04-03. CAVEAT: in-domain. AutomotiveUI-Bench-4K is published by the same authors as this model and shares the automotive-UI domain of its 17,708 fine-tuning instructions; the base (Molmo-7B-D-0924, a general pointing model) is out of domain on automotive UI.

benchmarks.name: AutomotiveUI-Bench-4K Test Action Grounding
benchmarks.config: Card table '| Model | Test Action Grounding | Expected Result Grounding | Expected Result Evaluation |': base Molmo-7B-D-0924 71.3 vs ELAM-7B 87.6. Full fine-tune (ms-swift) on 17,708 instructions/evaluations over 6,230 automotive UI images, German+English content, English prompts.
